title: First Draw
text: Total balls = 5 red + 3 blue = 8 balls\n\nP(first ball is red) = $\frac{5}{8}$

title: Second Draw (Without Replacement)
text:
After drawing one red ball:
- Red balls remaining = 4
- Total balls remaining = 7

P(second ball is red | first was red) = $ rac{4}{7}$

title: Apply the Product Rule
text: P(both red) = P(1st red) $\times$ P(2nd red | 1st red)\n$$= \frac{5}{8} \times \frac{4}{7} = \frac{20}{56} = \frac{5}{14}$$
